topics.name: AI Agent Security
topics.original_query: ("AI agent" OR "autonomous agent" OR "LLM agent" OR "intelligent agent") AND (security OR safety OR vulnerability OR attack OR defense OR robustness OR adversarial)
topics.api_query: (all:"AI agent" OR all:"autonomous agent" OR all:"LLM agent" OR all:"intelligent agent") AND (all:security OR all:safety OR all:vulnerability OR all:attack OR all:defense OR all:robustness OR all:adversarial)
topics.date_filter: client-side Atom updated timestamps; never lastUpdatedDate search field
topics.activation_approval: User explicitly approved original arXiv HTML only, removal of all preprocessing, permanent deletion without backup including PDFs for the 2 HTML-unavailable papers, and resumption of the existing HTML-only daily Cron after verification.
topics.no_change_policy: record successful zero-result run; no external notification
topics.overlap_policy: one global atomic directory lock; skip if busy; never automatically steal a stale lock
topics.missed_run_policy: next actual run discovers from persisted successful-search checkpoint, clamped to first-run floor; no one-run-per-missed-day replay
topics.backfill_policy: no captures earlier than first-run 24-hour floor; oldest pending first; cap is per KST date
topics.failure_policy: preserve failed HTML staging and pending on search/download/identity/hash failure; after 3 consecutive core failures set local safety_block; confirmed HTML unavailable is separate, warned and rechecked after 7 days, never counted as captured
topics.safety_pause_scope: local execution gate, not an automatic Hermes cron pause
